Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, an Internal Rotation reading; Technology and Energy were weakest, but the data does not show two independent confirmations for Risk-Off, so treat the signal with restraint. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in the Top 5); style mixed / no clear leadership.

3. Which sectors are lagging?

6. Momentum Stocks?

Major divergence across large-cap names signals a transitional tape: GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +1.77% | 1M: -18.23%) and AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -0.66% | 1M: +0.57%); watch for a trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are nearly flat on the week and positive over the month: JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.76% | 1M: +0.93%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +12.68%), and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +13.73%). 9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare held slightly positive for the week and gained 9.15% over the month: SYK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%) leads, while JNJ is ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.11% | 1M: +7.70%). UNH CORRECTION (1W: -3.15% | 1M: +6.25%) and LLY CORRECTION (1W: -4.48% | 1M: +15.77%) show short-term pullbacks; constituent-level positive breadth unavailable.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to relative-strength names such as SYK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%) and AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +2.06%); reduce exposure to persistent laggards such as NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%). Style mixed / no clear leadership; broad Top 5 leadership is offset by major cross-timeframe divergence.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BEARISH: Watch PLTR BELOW TREND (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -19.32%) and TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -4.47%) while their negative news and price action remain aligned.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (+2.49% weekly; +8.06% monthly) and Healthcare (+0.14% weekly; +9.15% monthly) show positive sector returns, led by AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +2.06%) and SYK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%). BEARISH: Technology (-6.73% weekly; -13.12% monthly) and Energy (-11.93% weekly; -7.00% monthly) remain weak; NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.80% | 1M: -19.02%) and OXY BELOW TREND (1W: -11.91% | 1M: -6.47%).

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?

GE (+55): $12.9 billion China deals; price confirms the catalyst, with GE ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.10% | 1M: +5.77%).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PLTR (-50): commercial-booking slowdown; PLTR BELOW TREND (1W: -12.89% | 1M: -19.32%), confirming weakness. TSLA (-45): Cybertruck-related concern; TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -10.40% | 1M: -4.47%), confirming weakness, while MSFT (-35) neocloud-deal pullback sentiment diverges from MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +1.53%).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF is the supplied regime; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with broad Top 5 leadership (4 sectors) but mixed confirmation and no clear Growth-versus-Value style. Relative strength includes SYK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.65% | 1M: +17.66%) and AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +2.06%). Monitor major trend divergence and Technology weakness, including bearish news versus rising price in MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +1.53%).
